reason: The hypothesis proposes adding a trace amount of yttrium to the specific HfNbTaTiZr alloy to improve oxidation resistance via the reactive-element effect. While the reactive-element effect is well-known, none of the provided passages study yttrium addition to HfNbTaTiZr or any refractory high-entropy alloy for oxidation protection. The passages focus on fluorine treatment of TiAl alloys, microstructural effects on oxidation of AlCoCrFeNi, or mechanical properties of HfNbTaTiZr-based alloys without addressing oxidation mitigation. The hypothesis therefore applies a known mechanism to a new material system not covered by the literature, making it a non-trivial transfer.
